raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.2.0"

package:
  name: polars-pairing
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/polars-pairing/polars_pairing-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 457eace625f57d31bb573b158c98bd75ca2fab33d3a181178ae47b6fb675d4de

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - crossenv
        - maturin >=1.15,<2
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - if: linux
      then:
        - make
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - maturin >=1.15,<2
  run:
    - python
    - polars >=2.0,<3

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - polars_pairing
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://apcamargo.github.io/polars-pairing
  summary: A Polars plugin providing pairing functions.
  description: |
    polars-pairing is a plugin provides pairing functions to Polars. These
    functions encode a pair of natural numbers into a single natural number.
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  documentation: https://apcamargo.github.io/polars-pairing
  repository: https://github.com/apcamargo/polars-pairing

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - apcamargo
